dishes.name: Limburgse vlaai
dishes.desc: Wide, shallow fruit pie with a yeast base. The pride of Limburg's bakeries, with cherry and apricot as favourites.

dishes.name: Rijstevlaai
dishes.desc: Vlaai filled with sweet rice pudding. A Limburg classic.

dishes.name: Maastrichts zoervleisj
dishes.desc: Marinated beef stew in vinegar, onion and gingerbread. Served in Maastricht restaurants with fries or bread.

dishes.name: Limburg appelstroop
dishes.desc: Thick apple syrup from Limburg orchards, spread on bread. A regional pantry staple.
